name: Elon
overview: The name Elon appears in Scripture in several distinct contexts, each revealing different aspects of God's providence in the history of His people. Elon is noted as a Hittite patriarch connected to Esau through marriage, highlighting the complex family relationships in Genesis 26:34 and 36:2. Additionally, Elon is identified as a son of Zebulun, whose descendants formed the family of the Elonites (Genesis 46:14; Numbers 26:26), demonstrating God's faithfulness in preserving the tribes of Israel. Furthermore, Elon is the name of a town in the territory of Dan (Joshua 19:43), and a Hebrew judge from the tribe of Zebulun who led Israel for ten years (Judges 12:11), emphasizing God's provision of leadership during times of national challenge.
